info.title: BASTION Guardian API
info.description: Versioned (/v1) API. Sessions use Sign-In with Ethereum (EIP-4361): GET /v1/auth/nonce → sign → POST /v1/auth/verify. State-changing authenticated calls require the X-CSRF-Token header. Data on chain 31337 is LOCAL SIMULATION output.

get.summary: Labeled fixture presets (same market as the Foundry vectors); not live data

post.summary: Run one Section 10 scenario (12 kinds) and the strategy comparison

get.summary: Issue a single-use SIWE nonce (5 min)

post.summary: Verify an EIP-4361 message + signature and open a session (httpOnly cookie + CSRF token)

get.summary: Current session (401 when signed out)

post.summary: Rotate the CSRF token for the current session (JSON body, same-origin only)

get.summary: Indexer checkpoints, deployment records and execution mode
Configured lending protocols (official vs fixture is explicit)
Token metadata (fixture tokens are flagged is_fixture)
Registered protection policies (public on-chain data)
Policy detail: versions, authorizations, budget, readiness and rescues
Guardian readiness history
Observed lending positions
Health-factor history for a position
On-chain trigger observations
Rescue intents (ledger state machine)
Full rescue receipt: intent, executions, solver fill, settlement claim and events
Cross-chain settlement claims
Registered solvers and their committed liquidity
Solver detail: commitments and fills
Daily metrics computed by analytics-worker from indexed data
Coverage shortfalls derived from the latest readiness snapshots (what solvers should commit on-chain)
EIP-712 domain and types for signing quotes

post.summary: Submit an EIP-712-signed indicative quote (authenticated by signature; no session required)

get.summary: Signed-in user, wallets and roles
Policies owned by any of the user's verified wallets
Open incidents affecting the user's policies
Delivery preferences (defaults when never set)
Linked notification channels

Confirm a channel with its code
Register a browser Web Push subscription

get.summary: Delivery history with lifecycle state
All incidents (auditor/admin)
Audit trail (auditor/admin)

post.summary: Grant or revoke a role for a verified wallet (admin)

get.summary: Server-Sent Events: risk observations, rescue executions, settlement events, readiness and incidents
get.description: text/event-stream. Event names: risk.observed, rescue.executed, settlement.event, readiness.updated, incident.updated. Resume with the Last-Event-ID header. Heartbeat comments every 15 s.
